' HELI ATTACK - a Defender for the ZX Spectrum Next, with a helicopter, in NTC BASIC.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' UFOs over the city, eight screens of it, end to end (fly off one end and you come back on at the
' other). Landers come down for the people on the ground and take them up: get one to the top and
' it turns into a mutant. Shoot a lander that's carrying someone, catch them as they fall and put
' them down again. Bombers lay mines, pods burst into swarmers, and take too long and the baiters
' come for you. Lose everyone on the ground and every lander turns mutant.
'
' Keys: Q A O P fly (or S X Z C, or 5 6 7 8, or a joystick). Space (or M, fire): shoot.
'       B (or Enter, fire 2): smart bomb - everything on the screen. H: hyperspace (you might not
'       come out of it in one piece).
'
' The city is one Layer 2 picture the hardware scrolls round (Scene.cls); the helicopter, the UFOs,
' the people and the explosions are sprites; the bullets and your tracers are moved and checked in
' Z80 (Bul.cls); the scanner and the panel are the tilemap.
Option Explicit
Option Turbo

Const WORLD = 2048, HALF = 1024
Const NU = 20, NP = 10, NB = 8
' sprite slots (Bul has 54-127)
Const SP_HELI = 0, SP_UFO = 2, SP_PEOPLE = 22, SP_BOOM = 32, SP_BEAM = 40, SP_WIN = 44, SP_HYPER = 45
' UFO kinds
Const K_LANDER = 1, K_MUTANT = 2, K_BOMBER = 3, K_POD = 4, K_SWARM = 5, K_BAITER = 6
' where you can fly (paper rows; the scanner is above)
Const YTOP = 44, YLOW = 168, GROUND = 176
Const PINK = 2, BLUE = 3

Dim longText As String Max 80
' the UFOs: kind, x (world pixels), y, x speed (8ths), y speed, a timer, who they've got (-1 none),
' when they fire next, x's 8ths
Dim uk(19) As Integer, ux(19) As Integer, uy(19) As Integer, uvx(19) As Integer, uvy(19) As Integer
Dim ut(19) As Integer, ug(19) As Integer, uf(19) As Integer, ufr(19) As Integer
' the people: 0 gone, 1 walking, 2 carried up, 3 falling, 4 hanging from you; x, y, way, fall speed
Dim ps(9) As Integer, px(9) As Integer, py(9) As Integer, pd(9) As Integer, pv(9) As Integer
Dim bx(7) As Integer, by(7) As Integer, bt(7) As Integer, bnext As Integer
' you: x (8ths of a world pixel), y, speed (8ths a frame), facing
Dim hx As Integer, hy As Integer, hvx As Integer, face As Integer, alive As Integer, inv As Integer, deadT As Integer, cool As Integer
Dim smart As Integer, smartT As Integer, smartWas As Integer, hyperWas As Integer, hyperT As Integer, carry As Integer
Dim camX As Integer, pan As Integer
Dim score As Long, hiscore As Long, lives As Integer, wave As Integer, over As Integer, nextLife As Long
Dim frames As Integer, msgT As Integer, scoreDirty As Integer, waveT As Integer, toCome As Integer, peopleLost As Integer
Dim i As Integer, k As Integer

Nx.Border 0
Tiles.Init
Spr.Init
GfxData.Load
Sfx.Init
Scene.Init
Bul.Init GfxData.S_SHOT
Bul.Limits 2000, 2000                   ' (the city joins up end to end: no ends to stop at)
Nx.Layers Nx.OrderSUL                    ' sprites over the panel, the panel over the city
Nx.Reg &H1C, 2                           ' the sprites cut to the paper (x halved: over the border)
Nx.Reg &H19, 16 : Nx.Reg &H19, 143 : Nx.Reg &H19, 32 : Nx.Reg &H19, 223
Nx.Reg &H15, Nx.RegGet(&H15) Or &H20
hiscore = 20000
Do
  Title
  Game
Loop

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the world joins up end to end
' where world x is on the screen (its paper x: -1024 .. 1023)
Function Sx(ByVal x As Integer) As Integer
  Sx = ((x - camX + WORLD + HALF) And (WORLD - 1)) - HALF
End Function

' from a to b the short way round (-1024 .. 1023)
Function Dif(ByVal a As Integer, ByVal b As Integer) As Integer
  Dif = ((b - a + WORLD + HALF) And (WORLD - 1)) - HALF
End Function

Function Wrap(ByVal x As Integer) As Integer
  Wrap = (x + WORLD) And (WORLD - 1)
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the panel and the scanner
Sub Hud()
  Tiles.Fill 0
  Tiles.Rect 0, 0, 40, 4, GfxData.T_HUD
  Tiles.Rect 4, 4, 32, 1, GfxData.T_SCANT
  Tiles.Rect 4, 5, 32, 2, GfxData.T_SCAN
  Tiles.Rect 4, 7, 32, 1, GfxData.T_SCANG
  Tiles.Text 4, 1, "SCORE"
  Tiles.Text 20, 1, "HI " & Right$("000000" & Trim$(Str$(hiscore)), 7)
  Tiles.Text 32, 1, "W" & Right$("0" & Trim$(Str$(wave)), 2)
  ShowScore
  ShowLives
End Sub

Sub ShowScore()
  Tiles.Text 10, 1, Right$("000000" & Trim$(Str$(score)), 7)
  scoreDirty = 0
End Sub

Sub ShowLives()
  For k = 0 To 5
    If k < lives Then Tiles.Put 4 + k, 2, GfxData.T_LIFE Else Tiles.Put 4 + k, 2, GfxData.T_HUD
    If k < smart Then Tiles.Put 12 + k, 2, GfxData.T_SMART Else Tiles.Put 12 + k, 2, GfxData.T_HUD
  Next
End Sub

Sub AddScore(ByVal n As Long)
  score = score + n
  scoreDirty = 1
  If score >= nextLife Then
    nextLife = nextLife + 10000
    lives = lives + 1 : smart = smart + 1
    ShowLives
    Sfx.Play 1, 60, -1, 14, 30, 0
  End If
End Sub

' a message across the middle for t frames (0: until the next)
Sub Message(ByVal m As String, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  longText = m
  Tiles.Rect 4, y, 32, 1, 0
  Tiles.Text 4 + (32 - Len(longText)) \ 2, y, longText
  If t Then msgT = t
End Sub

Sub ClearMessages()
  Tiles.Rect 4, 9, 32, 18, 0
End Sub

' the scanner: the whole city in 256 pixels (8 to 1), with you in the middle; every 4th frame
Sub Scanner()
  Dim n As Integer, base As Integer
  If (frames And 3) <> 1 Then Exit Sub
  Tiles.Rect 4, 5, 32, 2, GfxData.T_SCAN
  Tiles.Rect 4, 7, 32, 1, GfxData.T_SCANG
  base = Wrap(hx \ 8 - HALF)
  For n = 0 To NP - 1
    If ps(n) Then Dot base, px(n), py(n), 1
  Next
  For n = 0 To NU - 1
    If uk(n) Then Dot base, ux(n), uy(n), 0
  Next
  If alive Then Dot base, hx \ 8, hy, 2
  ' the part on the screen
  Spr.Put SP_WIN, ((camX - base) And (WORLD - 1)) \ 8 + 32, 44, GfxData.S_WINDOW, Spr.Scale2X
End Sub

Sub Dot(ByVal base As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
  Dim r As Integer, v As Integer
  r = (x - base) And (WORLD - 1)
  v = (y - 40) * 9 \ 141
  If v < 0 Then v = 0
  If v > 8 Then v = 8
  Tiles.Put 4 + r \ 64, 5 + v \ 3, GfxData.T_DOT + c * 12 + (v Mod 3) * 4 + (r And 63) \ 16
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the title
Function FireDown() As Integer
  FireDown = Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyM) Or ((Keys.Joystick(0) And Keys.JoyFire1) <> 0)
End Function

Sub Title()
  Dim y As Integer
  Spr.HideRange 0, 54 : Spr.Show
  Bul.Reset : Bul.Show
  wave = 1 : lives = 3 : score = 0 : smart = 3
  Hud
  Message "H E L I   A T T A C K", 10, 0
  Message "SAVE THE CITY FROM THE UFOS", 12, 0
  Message "QAOP / SXZC / 5678  FLY", 15, 0
  Message "SPACE SHOOT   B SMART BOMB", 16, 0
  Message "H HYPERSPACE", 17, 0
  Message "CATCH THE PEOPLE THEY DROP!", 19, 0
  Message "(C) 2026 CYBORG UNICORN", 26, 0
  ' a lander comes for someone; you, flying by
  camX = 0 : y = 0 : face = 1 : hy = 144
  Do
    camX = Wrap(camX + 1)
    Scene.Scroll camX
    Spr.Put SP_HELI, 40 + 24 - 8, hy + 24, GfxData.S_HELI + ((frames \ 2) And 1) * 2, 0
    Spr.Put SP_HELI + 1, 40 + 24 + 8, hy + 24, GfxData.S_HELI + ((frames \ 2) And 1) * 2 + 1, 0
    Spr.Put SP_UFO, 200 + 24, 30 + (frames \ 4) Mod 8 + 24, GfxData.S_LANDER + (frames \ 8) Mod 2, 0
    Frame
    Spr.Show
    Sfx.Update
    frames = frames + 1
    y = y + 1
    If y = 30 Then Message "PRESS SPACE", 23, 0
    If y = 60 Then Tiles.Rect 4, 23, 32, 1, 0 : y = 0
  Loop Until FireDown()
  Do
    Frame
  Loop While FireDown()
  ClearMessages
  Spr.HideRange 0, 54
  Sfx.Play 0, 200, -6, 15, 25, 0
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- a game
Sub Game()
  score = 0 : lives = 3 : wave = 1 : over = 0 : smart = 3 : nextLife = 10000
  For k = 0 To NP - 1
    ps(k) = 1
  Next
  Do
    WaveRun
    If over Then Exit Do
    wave = wave + 1
  Loop
  Nx.Reg &H70, 0
  If score > hiscore Then hiscore = score
  Message "GAME OVER", 14, 0
  For k = 1 To 250
    Frame
    Sfx.Update
    If k > 50 And FireDown() Then Exit For
  Next
  ClearMessages
End Sub

' the people back (every fifth wave, or at the start): spread along the ground
Sub People()
  For k = 0 To NP - 1
    ps(k) = 1 : px(k) = k * (WORLD \ NP) + Rnd(100) : py(k) = GROUND - 8 : pd(k) = 1 - 2 * Rnd(2) : pv(k) = 0
  Next
End Sub

Function PeopleLeft() As Integer
  Dim n As Integer
  n = 0
  For k = 0 To NP - 1
    If ps(k) Then n = n + 1
  Next
  PeopleLeft = n
End Function

Sub WaveRun()
  Dim b As Long, t As Integer, clearT As Integer
  Spr.HideRange 0, 54
  Bul.Reset
  For k = 0 To NB - 1
    bt(k) = 0
  Next
  For k = 0 To NU - 1
    uk(k) = 0
  Next
  If wave = 1 Or wave Mod 5 = 0 Then
    People
  Else
    ' the survivors back on the ground
    For k = 0 To NP - 1
      If ps(k) Then ps(k) = 1 : py(k) = GROUND - 8
    Next
  End If
  peopleLost = (PeopleLeft() = 0)
  ' the UFOs: landers come in groups of five; bombers and pods from the start
  toCome = 10 + wave * 2
  If toCome > 25 Then toCome = 25
  For k = 1 To 5 + wave
    If k <= 10 Then NewUFO K_LANDER
  Next
  If wave >= 2 Then
    For k = 1 To 1 + wave \ 2
      If k <= 4 Then NewUFO K_BOMBER
    Next
  End If
  If wave >= 3 Then
    For k = 1 To wave \ 2
      If k <= 3 Then NewUFO K_POD
    Next
  End If
  hx = 200 * 8 : hy = 100 : hvx = 0 : face = 1 : alive = 1 : inv = 100 : deadT = 0 : cool = 0 : smartT = 0 : carry = -1
  smartWas = 1 : hyperWas = 1 : hyperT = 0
  camX = 112 : pan = 0 : waveT = 0 : clearT = 0
  Hud
  Message "WAVE " & Trim$(Str$(wave)), 13, 100
  If peopleLost Then Message "THE CITY IS LOST: MUTANTS!", 15, 100 Else Message "SAVE THE PEOPLE!", 15, 100
  Do
    waveT = waveT + 1
    ' more landers, five at a time
    If toCome > 0 And ((waveT Mod 600) = 0 Or (Attackers() < 4 And (waveT Mod 50) = 0)) Then
      For k = 1 To 5
        If toCome > 0 Then NewUFO K_LANDER
      Next
    End If
    ' too slow: a baiter
    If waveT > 2500 And (waveT Mod 500) = 0 Then NewUFO K_BAITER
    You
    Camera
    UFOs
    Folk
    Booms
    SmartUpdate
    If alive Then Bul.Step Sx(hx \ 8), hy, pan Else Bul.Step 0, 0, pan
    If alive And inv = 0 And smartT = 0 Then
      If Bul.Hit() Then Die
    End If
    DrawHeli
    Scanner
    If scoreDirty And (frames And 3) = 0 Then ShowScore
    If msgT > 0 Then
      msgT = msgT - 1
      If msgT = 0 Then ClearMessages
    End If
    Frame
    Scene.Scroll camX
    Spr.Show
    Bul.Show
    Sfx.Update
    frames = frames + 1
    If alive = 0 And deadT = 0 And lives = 0 Then over = 1 : Exit Sub
    ' all the attackers down (baiters don't count)?
    If toCome = 0 And Attackers() = 0 Then
      clearT = clearT + 1
      If clearT = 30 Then
        t = PeopleLeft()
        b = CLng(wave) * 100 * t
        AddScore b
        Message "WAVE " & Trim$(Str$(wave)) & " CLEARED", 12, 0
        Message Trim$(Str$(t)) & " PEOPLE SAVED: BONUS " & Trim$(Str$(b)), 14, 0
        Sfx.Play 0, 100, -2, 15, 50, 0
      End If
      If clearT > 170 Then ClearMessages : Exit Sub
    End If
  Loop
End Sub

Function Attackers() As Integer
  Dim n As Integer, c As Integer
  c = 0
  For n = 0 To NU - 1
    If uk(n) > 0 And uk(n) <> K_BAITER Then c = c + 1
  Next
  Attackers = c
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- you
Sub You()
  Dim j0 As Integer, mx As Integer, my As Integer, v As Integer, sb As Integer, hy1 As Integer
  If alive = 0 Then
    If deadT > 0 Then
      deadT = deadT - 1
      If deadT = 0 And lives > 0 Then
        alive = 1 : inv = 150 : hy = 100 : hvx = 0 : smart = 3 : ShowLives
      End If
    End If
    Exit Sub
  End If
  ' hyperspace: gone for a moment, then somewhere else (and maybe in pieces)
  If hyperT > 0 Then
    hyperT = hyperT - 1
    If hyperT = 0 Then
      hx = Rnd(WORLD) * 8 : hy = YTOP + Rnd(YLOW - YTOP) : hvx = 0
      camX = Wrap(hx \ 8 - 128) : pan = 0
      Spr.Hide SP_HYPER
      If Rnd(4) = 0 Then Die
    End If
    Exit Sub
  End If
  j0 = Keys.Joystick(0)
  mx = 0 : my = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyO) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyZ) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyLeft) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyLeft) Then mx = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyP) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyC) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyRight) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyRight) Then mx = 1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyQ) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyS) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyUp) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyUp) Then my = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyA) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyX) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyDown) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyDown) Then my = 1
  If mx <> 0 Then
    face = mx
    hvx = hvx + mx * 3
    If hvx > 40 Then hvx = 40
    If hvx < -40 Then hvx = -40
  Else
    If hvx > 0 Then hvx = hvx - 1
    If hvx < 0 Then hvx = hvx + 1
  End If
  hx = (hx + hvx + WORLD * 8) And (WORLD * 8 - 1)
  hy = hy + my * 2
  If hy < YTOP Then hy = YTOP
  If hy > YLOW Then hy = YLOW
  ' the gun
  If cool > 0 Then cool = cool - 1
  If FireDown() And cool = 0 Then
    v = face * 14 + hvx \ 8
    Bul.Shot Sx(hx \ 8) + face * 14, hy + 3, v, 0, GfxData.S_SHOT
    cool = 4
    Sfx.Play 0, 30, 4, 10, 4, 0
  End If
  ' a smart bomb
  sb = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyB) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyEnter) Or ((j0 And Keys.JoyFire2) <> 0)
  If sb And smartWas = 0 And smart > 0 And smartT = 0 Then
    smart = smart - 1 : ShowLives
    smartT = 40
    SmartBomb
    Sfx.Play 2, 31, 0, 15, 60, 1
  End If
  smartWas = sb
  ' hyperspace
  sb = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyH)
  If sb And hyperWas = 0 Then
    hyperT = 30
    Spr.Put SP_HYPER, Sx(hx \ 8) + 24, hy + 24, GfxData.S_STARS, Spr.Scale2
    If carry >= 0 Then ps(carry) = 3 : pv(carry) = 0 : carry = -1
    Sfx.Play 1, 20, 6, 14, 30, 0
  End If
  hyperWas = sb
  If inv > 0 Then inv = inv - 1
  ' someone hanging on: put them down near the ground
  If carry >= 0 Then
    px(carry) = hx \ 8 : py(carry) = hy + 14
    If hy >= YLOW - 4 Then
      ps(carry) = 1 : py(carry) = GROUND - 8
      AddScore 500
      Message "SAFE! 500", 20, 50
      Sfx.Play 1, 80, -3, 14, 20, 0
      carry = -1
    End If
  End If
End Sub

' the view: you a third of the way in from the side you're leaving
Sub Camera()
  Dim want As Integer, was As Integer, d As Integer
  was = camX
  If face > 0 Then want = Wrap(hx \ 8 - 88) Else want = Wrap(hx \ 8 - 168)
  d = Dif(camX, want)
  If d > 7 Then d = 7
  If d < -7 Then d = -7
  camX = Wrap(camX + d)
  pan = Dif(was, camX)
End Sub

Sub DrawHeli()
  Dim fl As Integer, x As Integer, a As Integer, b As Integer
  If alive = 0 Or hyperT > 0 Or (inv And 4) <> 0 Then
    Spr.Hide SP_HELI : Spr.Hide SP_HELI + 1
  Else
    x = Sx(hx \ 8)
    a = GfxData.S_HELI + ((frames \ 2) And 1) * 2
    If face < 0 Then
      fl = Spr.MirrorX : b = a : a = a + 1
    Else
      fl = 0 : b = a + 1
    End If
    Spr.Put SP_HELI, x + 24 - 8, hy + 24, a, fl
    Spr.Put SP_HELI + 1, x + 24 + 8, hy + 24, b, fl
  End If
  If Bul.Sparked() Then Sfx.Play 1, 8, 2, 9, 3, 1
End Sub

Sub Die()
  alive = 0 : deadT = 100 : lives = lives - 1 : ShowLives
  Boom hx \ 8, hy
  Boom hx \ 8 - 10, hy - 6
  Boom hx \ 8 + 10, hy + 6
  k = Bul.Clear()
  If carry >= 0 Then ps(carry) = 3 : pv(carry) = 0 : carry = -1
  Spr.Hide SP_HELI : Spr.Hide SP_HELI + 1
  Sfx.Play 2, 31, 0, 15, 70, 1
  Sfx.Play 1, 300, 10, 15, 50, 0
End Sub

' every UFO on the screen goes, and every bullet
Sub SmartBomb()
  Dim n As Integer, x As Integer
  For n = 0 To NU - 1
    If uk(n) Then
      x = Sx(ux(n))
      If x > -8 And x < 264 Then KillUFO n
    End If
  Next
  k = Bul.Clear()
End Sub

Sub SmartUpdate()
  If smartT = 0 Then Exit Sub
  smartT = smartT - 1
  If smartT = 0 Then Nx.Reg &H70, 0 Else Nx.Reg &H70, (smartT \ 3) And 15
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the UFOs
Sub NewUFO(ByVal kd As Integer)
  Dim n As Integer, m As Integer
  m = -1
  For n = 0 To NU - 1
    If uk(n) = 0 And m < 0 Then m = n
  Next
  If m < 0 Then Exit Sub
  If kd = K_LANDER And peopleLost Then kd = K_MUTANT
  uk(m) = kd : ug(m) = -1 : ut(m) = Rnd(100) : ufr(m) = 0
  uf(m) = 60 + Rnd(120)
  ' somewhere off the screen
  ux(m) = Wrap(camX + 300 + Rnd(WORLD - 600))
  uy(m) = 50 + Rnd(70)
  uvx(m) = 4 + Rnd(6)
  If Rnd(2) Then uvx(m) = -uvx(m)
  uvy(m) = 0
  If kd = K_LANDER Then toCome = toCome - 1
  If kd = K_BAITER Then ux(m) = Wrap(hx \ 8 + 200 * face) : uy(m) = hy
  If kd = K_SWARM Then uvx(m) = 0
End Sub

Sub KillUFO(ByVal n As Integer)
  Dim pts As Integer, j As Integer
  Boom ux(n), uy(n)
  Select Case uk(n)
    Case K_LANDER
      pts = 150
    Case K_MUTANT
      pts = 150
    Case K_BOMBER
      pts = 250
    Case K_POD
      pts = 1000
    Case K_SWARM
      pts = 150
    Case Else
      pts = 200
  End Select
  ' a lander with someone: they fall
  If ug(n) >= 0 Then
    ps(ug(n)) = 3 : pv(ug(n)) = 0
    ug(n) = -1
  End If
  ' a pod: swarmers
  If uk(n) = K_POD Then
    For j = 1 To 3 + Rnd(3)
      Swarmer ux(n), uy(n)
    Next
  End If
  uk(n) = 0
  Bul.Off n
  Spr.Hide SP_UFO + n
  Spr.Hide SP_BEAM + (n And 3)
  AddScore pts
  Sfx.Play 2, 20 + Rnd(10), 4, 14, 18, 1
End Sub

Sub Swarmer(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Dim n As Integer
  For n = 0 To NU - 1
    If uk(n) = 0 Then
      uk(n) = K_SWARM : ux(n) = Wrap(x + Rnd(16) - 8) : uy(n) = y + Rnd(16) - 8 : uvx(n) = 0 : uvy(n) = 0
      ut(n) = Rnd(50) : ug(n) = -1 : uf(n) = 40 + Rnd(60) : ufr(n) = 0
      Exit Sub
    End If
  Next
End Sub

Sub UFOs()
  Dim n As Integer, x As Integer, h As Integer, d As Integer, pat As Integer, fl As Integer, j As Integer, best As Integer, bd As Integer
  For n = 0 To NU - 1
    If uk(n) Then
      ut(n) = ut(n) + 1
      ' shot?
      h = Bul.Hits(n)
      If h > 0 Then KillUFO n
    End If
    If uk(n) Then
      d = Dif(ux(n), hx \ 8)                 ' you, from it
      Select Case uk(n)
        Case K_LANDER
          If ug(n) >= 0 Then
            ' going up with someone
            uy(n) = uy(n) - 1
            j = ug(n) : px(j) = ux(n) : py(j) = uy(n) + 14
            Spr.Put SP_BEAM + (n And 3), Sx(ux(n)) + 24, uy(n) + 24 + 8, GfxData.S_BEAM, 0
            If uy(n) <= YTOP - 8 Then
              ' at the top: they're gone, and it's a mutant now
              ps(j) = 0 : ug(n) = -1 : uk(n) = K_MUTANT
              Spr.Hide SP_BEAM + (n And 3)
              Message "A MUTANT!", 20, 40
              Sfx.Play 1, 200, 20, 14, 30, 0
              If PeopleLeft() = 0 Then LostCity
            End If
          Else
            ' drifting; now and then it picks someone on the ground below
            ufr(n) = ufr(n) + uvx(n)
            ux(n) = Wrap(ux(n) + ufr(n) \ 8) : ufr(n) = ufr(n) Mod 8
            best = -1 : bd = 40
            For j = 0 To NP - 1
              If ps(j) = 1 Then
                If Abs(Dif(ux(n), px(j))) < bd Then bd = Abs(Dif(ux(n), px(j))) : best = j
              End If
            Next
            If best < 0 Then
              ' no one below: wander up and down
              If (ut(n) Mod 40) = 0 Then uvy(n) = Rnd(3) - 1
              uy(n) = uy(n) + uvy(n)
              If uy(n) < 50 Then uy(n) = 50
              If uy(n) > 130 Then uy(n) = 130
            ElseIf (ut(n) Mod 2) = 0 Then
              ' down to them
              ux(n) = Wrap(ux(n) + Sgn(Dif(ux(n), px(best))))
              uy(n) = uy(n) + 1
              If uy(n) >= GROUND - 24 And Abs(Dif(ux(n), px(best))) < 4 Then
                ug(n) = best : ps(best) = 2
                Sfx.Play 1, 400, -20, 13, 30, 0
                If Abs(Sx(ux(n))) < 300 Then Message "THEY'VE GOT SOMEONE!", 20, 40
              End If
            End If
          End If
          pat = GfxData.S_LANDER + (ut(n) \ 8) Mod 2 : fl = 0
          If (uf(n) <= 0) Then Shoot n, 14 + wave, 0
        Case K_MUTANT
          ' straight at you, jittering
          If (ut(n) And 1) = 0 Then
            ux(n) = Wrap(ux(n) + Sgn(d) * 2 + Rnd(3) - 1)
            uy(n) = uy(n) + Sgn(hy - uy(n)) * 1 + Rnd(3) - 1
          End If
          If uy(n) < YTOP Then uy(n) = YTOP
          If uy(n) > YLOW Then uy(n) = YLOW
          pat = GfxData.S_MUTANT + (ut(n) \ 4) Mod 2 : fl = Spr.Pal * 4
          If (uf(n) <= 0) Then Shoot n, 18 + wave, 1
        Case K_BOMBER
          ufr(n) = ufr(n) + uvx(n) \ 2
          ux(n) = Wrap(ux(n) + ufr(n) \ 8) : ufr(n) = ufr(n) Mod 8
          uy(n) = 80 + Sine1(ut(n)) \ 3
          If (ut(n) Mod 70) = 0 And Sx(ux(n)) > 8 And Sx(ux(n)) < 248 Then Bul.Fire Sx(ux(n)), uy(n), 0, 0, GfxData.S_MINE, 0
          pat = GfxData.S_BOMBER + (ut(n) \ 8) Mod 2 : fl = 0
        Case K_POD
          ufr(n) = ufr(n) + uvx(n) \ 2
          ux(n) = Wrap(ux(n) + ufr(n) \ 8) : ufr(n) = ufr(n) Mod 8
          uy(n) = 70 + Sine1(ut(n) + n * 30) \ 4
          pat = GfxData.S_POD + (ut(n) \ 8) Mod 2 : fl = 0
        Case K_SWARM
          ' fast at you across, overshooting
          uvx(n) = uvx(n) + Sgn(d)
          If uvx(n) > 28 Then uvx(n) = 28
          If uvx(n) < -28 Then uvx(n) = -28
          ufr(n) = ufr(n) + uvx(n)
          ux(n) = Wrap(ux(n) + ufr(n) \ 8) : ufr(n) = ufr(n) Mod 8
          uy(n) = uy(n) + Sgn(hy - uy(n))
          pat = GfxData.S_SWARMER + (ut(n) \ 4) Mod 2
          If uvx(n) > 0 Then fl = Spr.MirrorX Else fl = 0
          If (uf(n) <= 0) Then Shoot n, 20, 0
        Case K_BAITER
          ' keeps up with you, and shoots fans
          ux(n) = Wrap(ux(n) + Sgn(d) * 3 + hvx \ 8)
          uy(n) = uy(n) + Sgn(hy - 20 - uy(n))
          pat = GfxData.S_BAITER + (ut(n) \ 4) Mod 2 : fl = 0
          If (uf(n) <= 0) Then Shoot n, 22, 2
      End Select
      uf(n) = uf(n) - 1
      ' on the screen: the sprite, the target box; you running into it
      x = Sx(ux(n))
      If x > -16 And x < 272 Then
        Spr.Put SP_UFO + n, x + 24, uy(n) + 24, pat, fl
        If x > 4 And x < 252 Then Bul.Box n, x, uy(n), 9, 8 Else Bul.Off n
        If alive And inv = 0 And hyperT = 0 Then
          If Abs(x - (Sx(hx \ 8))) < 16 And Abs(uy(n) - hy) < 10 Then
            KillUFO n
            Die
          End If
        End If
      Else
        Spr.Hide SP_UFO + n
        Bul.Off n
        If uk(n) = K_LANDER And ug(n) >= 0 Then Spr.Hide SP_BEAM + (n And 3)
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' a sine wave: -64 .. 64 over 128 frames
Function Sine1(ByVal t As Integer) As Integer
  Dim u As Integer
  u = t And 127
  If u < 64 Then Sine1 = u * 2 - 64 Else Sine1 = 192 - u * 2
End Function

' UFO n shoots at you (if it's on the screen): kind 0 one bullet, 1 a pair, 2 a fan of 3
Sub Shoot(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal sp As Integer, ByVal kind As Integer)
  Dim x As Integer, a As Integer
  uf(n) = 70 + Rnd(70) - wave * 3
  If uf(n) < 25 Then uf(n) = 25
  If alive = 0 Then Exit Sub
  x = Sx(ux(n))
  If x < 0 Or x > 256 Then Exit Sub
  a = Bul.Aim(x, uy(n), Sx(hx \ 8), hy)
  If kind = 0 Then
    Bul.Fire x, uy(n), a, sp, GfxData.S_BULLET, PINK
  ElseIf kind = 1 Then
    Bul.Fire x, uy(n), a, sp, GfxData.S_BULLET, PINK
    Bul.Fire x, uy(n), (a + 8) And 255, sp, GfxData.S_BULLET, PINK
  Else
    Bul.Fire x, uy(n), a, sp, GfxData.S_BULLET + 1, BLUE
    Bul.Fire x, uy(n), (a + 14) And 255, sp, GfxData.S_BULLET + 1, BLUE
    Bul.Fire x, uy(n), (a - 14) And 255, sp, GfxData.S_BULLET + 1, BLUE
  End If
End Sub

' everyone's gone: every lander turns mutant
Sub LostCity()
  Dim n As Integer
  peopleLost = 1
  For n = 0 To NU - 1
    If uk(n) = K_LANDER Then uk(n) = K_MUTANT
  Next
  Message "THE CITY IS LOST!", 13, 100
  Sfx.Play 2, 40, 10, 15, 80, 1
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the people
Sub Folk()
  Dim n As Integer, x As Integer, pat As Integer, fl As Integer
  For n = 0 To NP - 1
    Select Case ps(n)
      Case 1
        ' walking about
        If (frames And 3) = 0 Then px(n) = Wrap(px(n) + pd(n))
        If Rnd(300) = 0 Then pd(n) = -pd(n)
        pat = GfxData.S_PERSON + (frames \ 8) Mod 2
      Case 3
        ' falling: from up high it's the end of them, unless you catch them
        pv(n) = pv(n) + 1
        py(n) = py(n) + pv(n) \ 8
        If py(n) >= GROUND - 8 Then
          py(n) = GROUND - 8
          If pv(n) > 22 Then
            ps(n) = 0 : Boom px(n), py(n)
            Spr.Hide SP_PEOPLE + n
            If PeopleLeft() = 0 Then LostCity
          Else
            ps(n) = 1 : AddScore 250
          End If
        End If
        ' caught?
        If ps(n) = 3 And alive And carry < 0 Then
          If Abs(Dif(hx \ 8, px(n))) < 14 And Abs(hy + 12 - py(n)) < 12 Then
            ps(n) = 4 : carry = n
            AddScore 500
            Message "CAUGHT! 500", 20, 50
            Sfx.Play 1, 100, -4, 14, 20, 0
          End If
        End If
        pat = GfxData.S_PERSON + 2
      Case 2, 4
        pat = GfxData.S_PERSON + 2
    End Select
    If ps(n) Then
      x = Sx(px(n))
      If pd(n) < 0 Then fl = Spr.MirrorX Else fl = 0
      If x > -16 And x < 272 Then Spr.Put SP_PEOPLE + n, x + 24, py(n) + 24, pat, fl Else Spr.Hide SP_PEOPLE + n
    Else
      Spr.Hide SP_PEOPLE + n
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- explosions
Sub Boom(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  bx(bnext) = x : by(bnext) = y : bt(bnext) = 16
  bnext = (bnext + 1) And 7
End Sub

Sub Booms()
  Dim n As Integer, x As Integer
  For n = 0 To NB - 1
    If bt(n) > 0 Then
      bt(n) = bt(n) - 1
      x = Sx(bx(n))
      If bt(n) = 0 Or x < -16 Or x > 272 Then
        Spr.Hide SP_BOOM + n
      Else
        Spr.Put SP_BOOM + n, x + 24, by(n) + 24, GfxData.S_BOOM + (15 - bt(n)) \ 4, 0
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

files.name: Nx.cls
files.text:
' Nx - the ZX Spectrum Next's own hardware, straight on the ports: NextRegs (#243B select,
' #253B value), the layer order, the border, palettes, the CPU speed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' No Z80N opcodes are used (plain out (c)), so any Z80 assembler builds it.
Option Explicit

' layer orders (NextReg #15 bits 4-2): first = on top. S sprites, L Layer 2, U ULA + tilemap
Public Const OrderSLU = 0
Public Const OrderLSU = 1
Public Const OrderSUL = 2
Public Const OrderLUS = 3
Public Const OrderUSL = 4
Public Const OrderULS = 5
' palettes for PalEntry / PalTable (NextReg #43 bits 6-4, the first of each pair)
Public Const PalULA = 0
Public Const PalLayer2 = 1
Public Const PalSprites = 2
Public Const PalTiles = 3

' Reg r, v: NextReg r = v
Public Sub Reg(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
#endasm
End Sub

' RegGet(r): NextReg r read back
Public Function RegGet(ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Layers order: which layer is on top (OrderSLU ...), sprites on and over the border kept
Public Sub Layers(ByVal order As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #15
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            and %11100011
            or e
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Border c: the border colour (0-7, port #FE)
Public Sub Border(ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalEntry which, index, colour: one colour (RRRGGGBB) of a palette (PalULA ... PalTiles, the
' first palette of each)
Public Sub PalEntry(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal index As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a                 ; palette select, bits 6-4
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; index
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; colour
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), l
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalTable which, first, count, address: count colours (1 byte each, RRRGGGBB) from memory
Public Sub PalTable(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer, ByVal address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; count (1-256: 0 = 256)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
pt_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, pt_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Raster(): the line the display is on now (0-311; 0-191 the picture)
Public Function Raster() As Integer
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
rs_again:
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in d, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            cp d
            jr nz, rs_again
            and 1
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

' Seed n: start Rnd's sequence from n (as Randomize n - kept here because Randomize with a
' variable doesn't link on its own in this NTC build: kw_seedv jumps into kw_seedl's section)
Public Sub Seed(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            or h
            jr nz, sd_ok
            inc l
sd_ok:
            ld (ntc_rnd_seed), hl
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Spr.cls
files.text:
' Spr - the Next's 128 hardware sprites, straight on the ports (#303B slot, #57 attributes).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' 4 bit patterns (GfxData.Load puts them in the sprite RAM), 16 x 16 pixels, scaled 1x - 8x.
' Put / Hide write a table in RAM; Show sends the table to the hardware in one go (do it just
' after Frame, so nothing moves half way down the screen).
' Coordinates are the tilemap's: 0, 0 is the top left of the whole 320 x 256 picture (the
' border included); the 256 x 192 paper is 32 - 287 across, 32 - 223 down. A sprite at x -16 .. or
' y -16 .. wraps (512): keep it hidden instead.
Option Explicit

' flags for Put: add them
Public Const MirrorX = 8
Public Const MirrorY = 4
Public Const Rotate = 2
Public Const Scale2X = &H800
Public Const Scale2Y = &H200
Public Const Scale2 = &HA00
Public Const Scale4X = &H1000
Public Const Scale4Y = &H400
Public Const Scale4 = &H1400
' a palette offset: Pal * n (n 0 - 15: spr_pal.png's row n)
Public Const Pal = 16

Private tab(639) As Byte          ' 128 x 5 attribute bytes
Private used As Integer           ' the highest slot Put + 1 (Show sends that many)

' Init: every sprite hidden, sprites on (over the border too), transparent colour 15
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 639
    tab(i) = 0
  Next
  For i = 3 To 639 Step 5
    tab(i) = &H40                ' hidden, but still 5 bytes (the upload stays in step)
  Next
  used = 128
  Show
  used = 0
  Nx.Reg &H4B, &HF               ' 4 bit sprites: colour 15 is transparent
  Nx.Reg &H15, (Nx.RegGet(&H15) And &H1C) Or 3   ' sprites on, over the border; the order kept
End Sub

' Put n, x, y, pattern, flags: sprite n (0-127) at x, y showing pattern (0-127), with flags
' (MirrorX + Scale2 + Pal * 2 ...)
Public Sub Put(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal pattern As Integer, ByVal flags As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld c, a
            inc a
            ld hl, {used}
            cp (hl)
            jr c, sp_low
            ld (hl), a
sp_low:
            ld l, c                 ; DE = tab + n * 5
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab}
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl                  ; x
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 0: x bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld c, a                 ; x bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; y
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 1: y bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld b, a                 ; y bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; pattern
            ld a, (hl)
            ex af, af'
            pop hl                  ; flags
            ld a, (hl)
            and #FE
            or c
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 2: palette offset, mirrors, rotate, x bit 8
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; scale bits
            ex af, af'
            ld l, a
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 3: visible, 5 bytes, pattern bits 6-1
            inc de
            ld a, l
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            or b
            ld b, a
            ld a, c
            and #1E
            or b
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 4: 4 bit, pattern bit 0, scale, y bit 8
#endasm
End Sub

' Hide n: sprite n not shown
Public Sub Hide(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), #40            ; not visible, 5 bytes kept (else the upload slips a byte)
#endasm
End Sub

' HideRange first, count: those sprites not shown
Public Sub HideRange(ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, hr_done
            ld b, a
            ex de, hl
            ld de, 5
hr_lp:
            ld (hl), #40
            add hl, de
            djnz hr_lp
hr_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the table to the hardware (the slots up to the highest one Put)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld a, ({used})
            or a
            jr z, sh_done
            ld bc, #303B
            xor a
            out (c), a
            ld a, ({used})
            ld e, a                 ; E sprites, 5 bytes each
            ld hl, {tab}
            ld c, #57
sh_lp:
            ld b, 5
            otir
            dec e
            jr nz, sh_lp
sh_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Visible(n): True when sprite n is shown
Public Function Visible(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld de, 0
            and #80
            jr z, vi_no
            dec de
vi_no:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

files.name: Tiles.cls
files.text:
' Tiles - the Next's tilemap as a 4 bit picture: 40 x 32 cells of 8 x 8 pixels over the whole
' 320 x 256 display (the border included), 16 colours (tile_pal.png), colour 15 transparent.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' The map stays where the platform put it (bank 5 + #2000, seen at #E000: one byte a cell, the
' tile number), so Print and Locate still work on it: the font is tiles 32-126 (a character's code
' is its tile). The tile definitions go to bank 5 + #0000 (#C000-#DFFF, 32 bytes a tile): the
' ULA screen's place, so the ULA is turned off. Don't use Mode or Cls after Init (Mode puts the
' platform's own text tiles back; Cls is all right but fills with tile 32).
' Print near the right edge or the last row wraps and scrolls: end prints with ; and keep them
' off row 32 and column 40.
Option Explicit

Public Const Cols = 40
Public Const Rows = 32
Private Const MAPA = &HE000

' Init: the tilemap on, 40 x 32, 4 bit tiles from #C000, no attribute bytes, over the ULA;
' the ULA off; no scroll; the whole picture
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H68, Nx.RegGet(&H68) Or &H80     ' the ULA off (its screen's RAM holds the tiles)
  Nx.Reg &H6E, &H20                         ' the map: bank 5 + #2000
  Nx.Reg &H6F, &H0                          ' the tile definitions: bank 5 + #0000
  Nx.Reg &H6C, 0                            ' every cell: palette offset 0, no mirror
  Nx.Reg &H4C, &HF                          ' colour 15 transparent
  Nx.Reg &H2F, 0 : Nx.Reg &H30, 0 : Nx.Reg &H31, 0
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 8                            ' the clip window: all of it
  Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 159 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 255
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &HA1                         ' on, 40 x 32, no attributes, 4 bit, over the ULA
End Sub

' Put x, y, t: cell x (0-39), y (0-31) shows tile t
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)              ; y
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; y * 40
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Get(x, y): the tile in cell x, y
Public Function Get(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ld e, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' At(px, py): the tile under pixel px, py (0-319, 0-255), 0 off the map
Public Function At(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; px
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; py
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, at_off
            ld a, d
            cp 2
            jr nc, at_off
            ld hl, -320
            add hl, de
            jr c, at_off
            srl d                   ; px / 8
            rr e
            srl e
            srl e
            ld a, c
            and #F8                 ; (py / 8) * 8
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, bc              ; (py / 8) * 40
            ld d, #E0
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            jr at_set
at_off:
            ld e, 0
at_set:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fill t: every cell tile t
Public Sub Fill(ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 40 * 32 - 1
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t: a block of cells
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Text x, y, s: text from cell x, y (the font tiles), no wrap, no scroll
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
tx_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, tx_done
            ld (de), a
            inc hl
            inc de
            ld a, d
            cp #E5                  ; past the map's end (#E500)
            jr nc, tx_done
            jr tx_lp
tx_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Scroll x, y: the tilemap moved by x (0-319) and y (0-255) pixels
Public Sub Scroll(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H2F, (x \ 256) And 3
  Nx.Reg &H30, x And 255
  Nx.Reg &H31, y And 255
End Sub

files.name: Sfx.cls
files.text:
' Sfx - sound effects on the Next's AY chip (the first of its three), straight on the ports:
' #FFFD picks a register, #BFFD writes it. Three channels, each playing one effect at a time:
' a tone or noise whose pitch slides and whose volume fades to nothing over its length.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' Call Update once a frame (50 a second).
'   Sfx.Play 0, 200, 8, 15, 12, 0     ' channel A: tone period 200, rising pitch... 12 frames
Option Explicit

Private per(2) As Integer         ' the tone period now (12 bits; noise: 0-31)
Private slide(2) As Integer       ' added to it each frame
Private vol(2) As Integer         ' the volume it starts at (0-15)
Private total(2) As Integer       ' its length in frames
Private left(2) As Integer        ' frames to go (0 = silent)
Private nse(2) As Integer         ' 1 = noise, 0 = tone
Private mix As Integer

Private Sub W(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #FFFD
            out (c), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld b, #BF
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Init: AY 1 picked (the Next has three: Turbosound), every channel quiet
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  Out &HFFFD, &HFF                 ' AY 1 (Turbosound: #FF, #FE, #FD pick the chips)
  For i = 0 To 13
    W i, 0
  Next
  W 7, &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
  Next
End Sub

' Play ch, period, slidePerFrame, volume, frames, noise: start an effect on channel ch (0-2)
Public Sub Play(ByVal ch As Integer, ByVal period As Integer, ByVal sl As Integer, ByVal volume As Integer, ByVal frames As Integer, ByVal noise As Integer)
  If ch < 0 Or ch > 2 Then Exit Sub
  per(ch) = period : slide(ch) = sl : vol(ch) = volume : total(ch) = frames : left(ch) = frames : nse(ch) = noise
End Sub

' Busy(ch): True while channel ch plays
Public Function Busy(ByVal ch As Integer) As Integer
  Busy = (left(ch) > 0)
End Function

' Update: once a frame - the pitches slide, the volumes fade, the AY written
Public Sub Update()
  Dim i As Integer, v As Integer, p As Integer
  mix = &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    If left(i) > 0 Then
      v = (vol(i) * left(i) + total(i) - 1) \ total(i)
      p = per(i)
      If nse(i) Then
        W 6, p And 31
        mix = mix And Not (8 * (2 ^ i))
      Else
        W i * 2, p And 255
        W i * 2 + 1, (p \ 256) And 15
        mix = mix And Not (2 ^ i)
      End If
      W 8 + i, v
      per(i) = per(i) + slide(i)
      If per(i) < 1 Then per(i) = 1
      left(i) = left(i) - 1
    Else
      W 8 + i, 0
    End If
  Next
  W 7, mix
End Sub

' Quiet: every channel stopped
Public Sub Quiet()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
    W 8 + i, 0
  Next
End Sub

files.name: Bul.cls
files.text:
' Bul - the bullet engine: 52 enemy bullets and 22 player shots as hardware sprites 54-127,
' moved, checked and drawn in Z80 every frame. (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' This copy is for ATTACK OF THE CYBORG UNICORNS 2: the play area is the whole 256 x 192 paper
' under a 32 pixel HUD, scrolling sideways (the pan); shots fly any way, each its own pattern. Coordinates are the paper's (0-255 across, 0-191 down; Show adds 24 to put
' them on the sprites' screen). Positions are centres.
' Enemy bullets move in 1/256ths of a pixel (an angle and a speed: Fire); they go when they leave
' the play area at the top or bottom (rows 36-187 - the HUD is above), or get more than two screens
' off either side. Off the screen they keep flying with the ground, unseen, so they are still
' there when the view scrolls back (1.1). Step tells you if one is on the player (within
' 3 pixels of the centre: the hit box is the ship's middle).
' Limits l, r (1.1): how far the view can still scroll left and right; a bullet past either end of
' the plain can never be seen again, so it goes (Main calls it each frame, before Step).
' Shots fly vx across and vy down a frame and hit boxes: up to 24
' targets Main puts down each frame (Box n, x, y, half width, half height), each counting its hits
' until Hits(n) reads them.
' Step's pan is how far the view moved this frame (pixels, + right): everything flying moves the
' other way with the ground.
' A frame:  Bul.Step px, py, pan  (moves all, writes the sprites' table)
'           Frame : Bul.Show (the table to the hardware)
Option Explicit

Private eb(571) As Byte           ' 52 bullets x 11: x (lo, hi), y (lo, hi), vx, vy, pattern (255 = none), palette, x's screen (-2 .. 2)
Private sh(131) As Byte           ' 22 shots x 6: x, y, vx, vy, on, pattern
Private bx(143) As Byte           ' 24 boxes x 6: on, x, y, half width, half height, hits
Private att(389) As Byte          ' 74 sprites x 5
Private hitF As Integer, live As Integer, spk As Integer, spkX As Integer, spkY As Integer
Private cnt As Integer, ang As Integer, tmp As Integer, vx As Integer, vy As Integer
Private sa3 As Integer, sa4 As Integer, six As Integer, blo As Integer, bhi As Integer
Private atn(16) As Integer

' Init shotPattern: everything cleared, the shots' sprite pattern
Public Sub Init(ByVal shotPattern As Integer)
  Dim k As Integer
  sa3 = &HC0 Or (shotPattern \ 2)
  sa4 = &H80 Or ((shotPattern And 1) * 64)
  ' atan(k / 16) in 256ths of a turn
  atn(0) = 0 : atn(1) = 3 : atn(2) = 5 : atn(3) = 8 : atn(4) = 10 : atn(5) = 12 : atn(6) = 15 : atn(7) = 17
  atn(8) = 19 : atn(9) = 21 : atn(10) = 23 : atn(11) = 25 : atn(12) = 26 : atn(13) = 28 : atn(14) = 29
  atn(15) = 31 : atn(16) = 32
  tmp = Sines()
  Reset
End Sub

Public Sub Limits(ByVal l As Integer, ByVal r As Integer)
  blo = -l - 8 : bhi = 263 + r
End Sub

' Reset: no bullets, no shots, no boxes
Public Sub Reset()
#asm
            ld hl, {eb} + 8
            ld de, 11
            ld b, 52
rs_b:
            ld (hl), 255
            add hl, de
            djnz rs_b
            ld hl, {sh}
            ld b, 132
rs_s:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            djnz rs_s
            ld hl, {bx}
            ld b, 144
rs_x:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            djnz rs_x
            ld hl, {att}
            ld b, 74
rs_a:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), #40
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            djnz rs_a
#endasm
End Sub

' Clear(): every enemy bullet gone (a bomb, a boss beaten): how many there were
Public Function Clear() As Integer
#asm
            ld hl, {eb} + 8
            ld de, 11
            ld bc, 52 * 256          ; (B: 52 bullets, C: the count)
cl_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            cp 255
            jr z, cl_n
            ld (hl), 255
            inc c
cl_n:
            add hl, de
            djnz cl_lp
            pop hl
            ld (hl), c
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fire x, y, a, spd, pat, pal: an enemy bullet from x, y going way a (0-255: 0 down, 64 right,
' 128 up, 192 left) at spd sixteenths of a pixel a frame, sprite pattern pat in palette pal
Public Sub Fire(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal a As Integer, ByVal spd As Integer, ByVal pat As Integer, ByVal pal As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_x + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_y + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({ang}), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_s1 + 1), a
            ld (fi_s2 + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_p + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and #F0
            ld (fi_c + 1), a
            ld hl, {eb} + 8         ; a free one
            ld de, 11
            ld b, 52
fi_find:
            ld a, (hl)
            cp 255
            jr z, fi_got
            add hl, de
            djnz fi_find
            jp fi_done
fi_got:
            ld de, -8
            add hl, de
            ld ({tmp}), hl
            ld a, ({ang})           ; vx = sin(a) * spd / 8
            ld hl, fn_bul_sines_sn_data
            add a, l
            ld l, a
            jr nc, fi_n1
            inc h
fi_n1:
            ld a, (hl)
            ld c, a
            bit 7, a
            jr z, fi_p1
            neg
fi_p1:
            ld d, a
fi_s1:
            ld e, 0
fi_zm1:
            db #ED, #30             ; mul d, e
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            bit 7, c
            jr z, fi_v1
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a
fi_v1:
            ld ({vx}), de
            ld a, ({ang})           ; vy = sin(a + 64) * spd / 8
            add a, 64
            ld hl, fn_bul_sines_sn_data
            add a, l
            ld l, a
            jr nc, fi_n2
            inc h
fi_n2:
            ld a, (hl)
            ld c, a
            bit 7, a
            jr z, fi_p2
            neg
fi_p2:
            ld d, a
fi_s2:
            ld e, 0
fi_zm2:
            db #ED, #30
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            bit 7, c
            jr z, fi_v2
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a
fi_v2:
            ld ({vy}), de
            ld hl, ({tmp})
            ld (hl), 128
            inc hl
fi_x:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 128
            inc hl
fi_y:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld de, ({vx})
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld de, ({vy})
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
fi_p:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
fi_c:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0              ; on this screen
fi_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Shot x, y, vx, vy, pat: a player shot from x, y, flying vx across and vy down a frame
' (-20 .. 20), sprite pattern pat
Public Sub Shot(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal sx As Integer, ByVal sy As Integer, ByVal pat As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (so_x + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (so_y + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (so_v + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (so_w + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (so_p + 1), a
            ld hl, {sh} + 4
            ld de, 6
            ld b, 22
so_find:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, so_got
            add hl, de
            djnz so_find
            jr so_done
so_got:
            ld (hl), 1
            inc hl
so_p:
            ld (hl), 0
            dec hl
            dec hl
so_w:
            ld (hl), 0
            dec hl
so_v:
            ld (hl), 0
            dec hl
so_y:
            ld (hl), 0
            dec hl
so_x:
            ld (hl), 0
so_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Box n, x, y, hw, hh: target n (0-23) this frame, centred at x, y, hw across and hh down from
' the centre to its edges
Public Sub Box(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal hw As Integer, ByVal hh As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a                 ; HL = bx + n * 6
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {bx}
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), 1
            inc hl
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Off n: target n gone (its hits kept until Hits reads them)
Public Sub Off(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {bx}
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Sub

' Hits(n): the shots that hit target n since the last Hits(n)
Public Function Hits(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {bx} + 5
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (hl), 0
            pop hl
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Step px, py, pan: every bullet and shot moved (the view moved pan pixels), checked, put in the
' sprites' table
Public Sub Step(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer, ByVal pan As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (st_px + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (st_py + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (st_pan + 1), a
            ld (ss_pan + 1), a
            ld ({six}), ix
            xor a
            ld ({hitF}), a
            ld ({live}), a
            ld ({spk}), a
            ld a, (st_pan + 1)      ; the pan's sign, for the screen byte
            rla
            sbc a, a
            ld (st_pane + 1), a
            ld ix, {eb}
            ld de, {att}
            ld a, 52
            ld ({cnt}), a
st_lp:
            ld a, (ix + 8)
            cp 255
            jp z, st_free
            ld c, a                 ; the pattern
            ld a, (ix + 5)          ; x += vx - pan, over 3 bytes (the screen byte: -2 .. 2)
            rla
            sbc a, a
            ld b, a                 ; vx's sign
            ld a, (ix + 0)
            add a, (ix + 4)
            ld (ix + 0), a
            ld a, (ix + 1)
            adc a, (ix + 5)
            ld (ix + 1), a
            ld a, (ix + 10)
            adc a, b
            ld (ix + 10), a
            ld a, (ix + 1)
st_pan:
            sub 0
            ld (ix + 1), a
            ld a, (ix + 10)
st_pane:
            sbc a, 0
            ld (ix + 10), a
            add a, 2                ; more than two screens away: gone
            cp 5
            jp nc, st_kill
            ld ({tmp}), de          ; past either end of the plain: gone (de: the sprites' table;
            ld h, (ix + 10)         ; no push: sp is the program here)
            ld l, (ix + 1)
            ld de, ({blo})
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp m, st_kpop
            ld d, (ix + 10)
            ld e, (ix + 1)
            ld hl, ({bhi})
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp m, st_kpop
            ld de, ({tmp})
            ld a, (ix + 2)          ; y += vy
            add a, (ix + 6)
            ld (ix + 2), a
            ld a, (ix + 3)
            adc a, (ix + 7)
            ld (ix + 3), a
            cp 36
            jp c, st_kill
            cp 188
            jp nc, st_kill
            ld a, (ix + 10)         ; off the screen: flying, not drawn
            or a
            jr nz, st_hid
            ld a, (ix + 1)
            cp 4
            jr c, st_hid
            cp 252
            jr nc, st_hid
            ld a, (ix + 3)
st_py:
            sub 0                   ; on the player: within 3 both ways
            add a, 3
            cp 7
            jr nc, st_nohit
            ld a, (ix + 1)
st_px:
            sub 0
            add a, 3
            cp 7
            jr nc, st_nohit
            ld a, 1
            ld ({hitF}), a
st_nohit:
            ld hl, {live}
            inc (hl)
            ld a, (ix + 1)          ; the sprite: x + 24 (9 bits), y + 24
            add a, 24
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            sbc a, a
            and 1
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ix + 3)
            add a, 24
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, (ix + 9)
            or b
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, c
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, c
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            jr st_next
st_hid:
            ld hl, {live}
            inc (hl)
            jr st_free
st_kpop:
            ld de, ({tmp})
st_kill:
            ld (ix + 8), 255
st_free:
            xor a
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, #40
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            xor a
            ld (de), a
            inc de
st_next:
            ld bc, 11
            add ix, bc
            ld hl, {cnt}
            dec (hl)
            jp nz, st_lp
            ; ---- the shots
            ld ix, {sh}
            ld a, 22
            ld ({cnt}), a
ss_lp:
            ld a, (ix + 4)
            or a
            jp z, ss_free
            ld a, (ix + 2)          ; x += vx - pan (it goes when it wraps or leaves)
ss_pan:
            sub 0
            ld c, a
            ld a, (ix + 0)
            add a, c
            ld (ix + 0), a
            bit 7, c
            jr nz, ss_neg
            jp c, ss_kill
            jr ss_chk
ss_neg:
            jp nc, ss_kill
ss_chk:
            cp 4
            jp c, ss_kill
            cp 252
            jp nc, ss_kill
            ld c, (ix + 3)          ; y += vy
            ld a, (ix + 1)
            add a, c
            ld (ix + 1), a
            bit 7, c
            jr nz, ss_negy
            jp c, ss_kill
            jr ss_chky
ss_negy:
            jp nc, ss_kill
ss_chky:
            cp 36
            jp c, ss_kill
            cp 188
            jp nc, ss_kill
            ld hl, {bx}             ; the targets
            ld b, 24
ss_box:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, ss_skip6
            inc hl
            ld a, (ix + 0)
            sub (hl)
            jr nc, ss_ax
            neg
ss_ax:
            inc hl
            inc hl
            cp (hl)
            jr nc, ss_skip3
            dec hl
            ld a, (ix + 1)
            sub (hl)
            jr nc, ss_ay
            neg
ss_ay:
            inc hl
            inc hl
            cp (hl)
            jr nc, ss_skip4
            inc hl
            inc (hl)                ; a hit
            jr nz, ss_hc
            dec (hl)
ss_hc:
            ld a, (ix + 0)
            ld ({spkX}), a
            ld a, (ix + 1)
            ld ({spkY}), a
            ld a, 1
            ld ({spk}), a
            jr ss_kill
ss_skip3:
            inc hl
            inc hl
            inc hl
            djnz ss_box
            jr ss_draw
ss_skip4:
            inc hl
            inc hl
            djnz ss_box
            jr ss_draw
ss_skip6:
            ld a, l
            add a, 6
            ld l, a
            jr nc, ss_nc
            inc h
ss_nc:
            djnz ss_box
ss_draw:
            ld a, (ix + 0)
            add a, 24
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            sbc a, a
            and 1
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ix + 1)
            add a, 24
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, (ix + 2)          ; flying left: mirrored; up or down: turned
            and #80
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            or b
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ix + 2)          ; (turned only when it flies straight up or down)
            or a
            ld a, b
            jr nz, ss_flat
            or 2
ss_flat:
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, (ix + 5)          ; its own pattern
            ld c, a
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, c
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            jr ss_next
ss_kill:
            ld (ix + 4), 0
ss_free:
            xor a
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, #40
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            xor a
            ld (de), a
            inc de
ss_next:
            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc ix
            ld hl, {cnt}
            dec (hl)
            jp nz, ss_lp
            ld ix, ({six})
#endasm
End Sub

' Near(x, y): how many enemy bullets are within 7 pixels of x, y - they go (a gun hit)
Public Function Near(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (nr_x + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (nr_y + 1), a
            ld ({six}), ix
            ld ix, {eb}
            ld b, 52
            ld c, 0
nr_lp:
            ld a, (ix + 8)
            cp 255
            jr z, nr_next
            ld a, (ix + 10)
            or a
            jr nz, nr_next
            ld a, (ix + 1)
nr_x:
            sub 0
            add a, 7
            cp 15
            jr nc, nr_next
            ld a, (ix + 3)
nr_y:
            sub 0
            add a, 7
            cp 15
            jr nc, nr_next
            ld (ix + 8), 255
            inc c
nr_next:
            ld de, 11
            add ix, de
            djnz nr_lp
            ld ix, ({six})
            pop hl
            ld (hl), c
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Show: the table to sprites 50-127 (straight after Frame)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld bc, #303B
            ld a, 54
            out (c), a
            ld hl, {att}
            ld bc, 185 * 256 + #57
            otir
            ld b, 185
            otir
#endasm
End Sub

' Hit(): True when a bullet was on the player in the last Step
Public Function Hit() As Integer
  Hit = hitF
End Function

' Count(): the enemy bullets flying
Public Function Count() As Integer
  Count = live
End Function

' Sparked(): True when a shot hit something in the last Step (SparkX / SparkY: the last one)
Public Function Sparked() As Integer
  Sparked = spk
End Function

' Aim(x, y, tx, ty): the way (0-255, as Fire's) from x, y to tx, ty
Public Function Aim(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal tx As Integer, ByVal ty As Integer) As Integer
  Dim dx As Integer, dy As Integer, ax As Integer, ay As Integer, t As Integer
  dx = tx - x : dy = ty - y
  ax = Abs(dx) : ay = Abs(dy)
  If ax = 0 And ay = 0 Then
    Aim = 0
    Exit Function
  End If
  If ax <= ay Then
    t = atn(ax * 16 \ ay)
  Else
    t = 64 - atn(ay * 16 \ ax)
  End If
  If dy >= 0 Then
    If dx >= 0 Then Aim = t Else Aim = (256 - t) And 255
  Else
    If dx >= 0 Then Aim = 128 - t Else Aim = 128 + t
  End If
End Function
